events.status: Corrected Seminole County figures; the district contest is unofficial and not certified
events.authority: Seminole County Elections Department, with figures on the Georgia Secretary of State results site
events.summary: Seminole County's election-night report, marked “Unofficial & Incomplete,” counted 2,523 ballots. The county elections supervisor states that every memory card was accounted for, that the election management system had not completed its final validate-and-publish step for the last precinct, and that the completed report counted 2,911 ballots, an increase of 388. The Secretary of State's results site shows the corrected Seminole figures below and labels the county's results official; it labels the district-wide House District 154 results unofficial.

events.status: Unofficial recount result; not yet certified by the state
events.summary: Miami-Dade County's canvassing board signed a certificate of a second set of unofficial returns for U.S. House District 27, posted as the district's recount report. By Midterm Watch's arithmetic, compared with the county's results page before the recount, Maria Elvira Salazar's total is 9 votes lower and Eliott Rodriguez's 5 votes lower; the leader did not change. The 2026 district lies entirely within Miami-Dade, so these are the district's figures. The Florida Elections Canvassing Commission certifies federal contests separately.

contests.scope: Full District 27 contest; the 2026 district lies entirely within Miami-Dade
contests.change: Salazar −9; Rodriguez −5; margin 1,090 → 1,086 (all Midterm Watch arithmetic)

caveats: The earlier figures come from Midterm Watch's own capture of the county's results page at 17:13 UTC on November 10 (the page was last updated November 7); the page now links the certificate instead of showing them.

Under s. 102.166(1), Florida Statutes, a manual recount must be ordered when the second set of unofficial returns shows a margin of one-quarter of a percent or less; Midterm Watch's arithmetic from the certificate gives about 0.44%.
Two board signatures are dated 11/10/2026; a third handwritten date is hard to read.
No state certification of this contest is cited; under s. 102.111, Florida Statutes, the Elections Canvassing Commission certifies federal returns on the 14th day after a general election.
